# Soft-thresholded ridge, from theory to reproducible code

![softridge and scaleCorrection: soft thresholding and corrected
scaling](reference/figures/banner.svg)

**softridge** fits soft-thresholded ridge (STR), computes
fixed-parameter Gaussian risk and SURE, and supports cross-validation
and least-squares refitting. Its **scaleCorrection** companion fits
optimism-corrected scaled STR (SSTR) alongside a matched Ridge-c0
control. Numerical kernels use **RcppArmadillo**.

[Get
started](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/articles/getting-started.html)
· [Function
reference](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/index.html) ·
[Scaling
companion](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/scaleCorrection/) ·
[Reproduce the
studies](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/articles/reproduction.html)

## Two packages, complementary roles

| Package | Purpose | Entry points |
|:---|:---|:---|
| softridge | STR fitting, fixed-tuning risk and SURE, CV, LS refitting | [`hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md), [`cv_hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/cv_hr.md), [`hr_risk()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_risk.md), [`hr_sure()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_sure.md) |
| scaleCorrection | Corrected SSTR and matched Ridge-c0 tuning on a shared CV surface | `corrected_pair()` |

The manuscript calls the estimators **STR** and **SSTR**. Historical
function names such as
[`hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md) are
retained for compatibility. `scale = TRUE` in
[`hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md) or
[`cv_hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/cv_hr.md)
requests the earlier training LS scale (**SSTR-LS**); the corrected SSTR
is obtained from
[`scaleCorrection::corrected_pair()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/scaleCorrection/man/corrected_pair.html).

## Install from GitHub

R, a working C++17 toolchain, and the declared package dependencies are
required. Install `remotes` separately if it is not already available,
then run:

``` r

remotes::install_github("byuzbasi/softridge", upgrade = "never")
remotes::install_github("byuzbasi/softridge", subdir = "companion/scaleCorrection",
                        upgrade = "never")
```

These are GitHub research packages; no CRAN availability is claimed.
Dependency lists and recorded study environments are documented in the
guides.

## A small STR fit

``` r

library(softridge)
set.seed(25)
X <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 100), 60, 100)
beta <- c(2, -1.5, 1, rep(0, 97))
y <- drop(X %*% beta + rnorm(60))
foldid <- rep(1:3, length.out = 60)
grid <- hr_grid(X, y, nk = 3, ng = 5)
fit <- cv_hr(X, y, grid = grid, foldid = foldid)
head(fit$coef)
```

This is a software demonstration, not a simulation performance result.
The [scaling
guide](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/articles/scaling.html) shows
the corrected SSTR and its matched Ridge control using the same
observations.

[Threshold

are analytic software demonstrations with their seeds and source code
stated.

## What the theory computes

[`hr_risk()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_risk.md)
evaluates coefficient risk for the estimable projection under a fixed
Gaussian design model.
[`hr_sure()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_sure.md)
evaluates fixed-design prediction risk with fixed tuning and known error
variance. New-covariate prediction and recovery of the original
coefficient support are distinct objectives. The corrected fitted scale
and data-adaptive tuning are assessed empirically; the fixed-parameter
unbiasedness formulas do not extend automatically to them.

## Reproduction materials

[`reproduction/`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reproduction/)
contains source packages, frozen designs/seeds and portable runners for
the separately reported **22-setting reference study** and
**192-scenario independent study**. The reference uses the original R
`softridge` 0.4.0; the independent study uses RcppArmadillo `softridge`
0.3.0.1 and `scaleCorrection` 0.1.0. Their CV protocols differ and are
not pooled. Original archives are retained byte for byte in separate
library workflows.

``` sh
cd reproduction
python3 verify_sources.py
Rscript --vanilla RUNME.R --help
```

No full study runs automatically. Downloading real data and starting a
full numerical rerun both require explicit commands. Saved result tables
and manuscript PDFs are distributed separately from this software
repository.

## Citation and authorship

Software: Mohammad Arashi and Bahadir Yuzbasi. See
[`CITATION.cff`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/CITATION.cff) and
`citation("softridge")` / `citation("scaleCorrection")`.

Companion manuscript: Bahadir Yuzbasi and Mohammad Arashi,
*Soft-thresholded ridge estimation of an estimable projection*,
unpublished manuscript (2026). No journal acceptance or DOI is claimed.

## Development and validation

See [VALIDATION.md](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/VALIDATION.md),
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/CONTRIBUTING.md),
and [release notes](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/NEWS.md).
Report reproducible problems through [GitHub
issues](https://github.com/byuzbasi/softridge/issues). Both packages use
GPL (\>= 2); original authorship is preserved.

# Package index

## Fit STR and choose tuning parameters

- [`hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md)
  [`coef(`*`<hr>`*`)`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md)
  [`predict(`*`<hr>`*`)`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr.md)
  : Soft-thresholded ridge (STR) estimator
- [`cv_hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/cv_hr.md) :
  Cross-validated STR estimator
- [`hr_grid()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_grid.md)
  : Default tuning grids for the STR estimator

## Fixed-parameter risk and SURE

- [`hr_risk()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_risk.md)
  : Exact finite-sample moments and risk of the STR estimator
- [`hr_sure()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/hr_sure.md)
  : Stein unbiased risk estimate and degrees of freedom of the STR fit
- [`sure_hr()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/sure_hr.md)
  : STR estimator tuned by the Stein unbiased risk estimate

## Threshold and ridge primitives

- [`soft_threshold()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/soft_threshold.md)
  : Soft-thresholding operator
- [`ridge_path()`](https://byuzbasi.github.io/softridge/reference/ridge_path.md)
  : Ridge regression path computed through the singular value
  decomposition
